pass.answer: The release workflow sets it from the pushed tag; nobody edits it by hand in a PR or commit.
Push the v1.8.0 tag and release.yml writes the version from it. Don't touch pyproject.toml's version.
From the tag: scripts/set_version.py runs in the release workflow on the tag push, so the version in pyproject.toml is never bumped by hand.

fail.answer: Bump it by hand in the release PR, alongside the release notes.
Either bump it in the release PR or let the workflow set it from the tag.

fail.why: states the value, not how it is set
